sections.title: Applied AI: A Practical Introduction
sections.description: This course introduces students to artificial intelligence as a practical professional skill. Students develop the critical fluency needed to use AI tools effectively, evaluate their outputs accurately, and apply them responsibly across a range of workplace contexts. Topics include how AI systems work, the nature and limits of large language models, bias and framing in AI outputs, and AI's implications for work and society. No technical or statistical background is required.
